In order to succeed in this game, remember the following
points:

Keep an eye on the colour of the Gnomes

Notice the forest that each Gnome leads you to: Bright
forest or Dark forest

Observe which colour Gnomes provides you with the highest
number of mushrooms and select these Gnomes when they appear in the pairs

Don’t be discouraged if the Gnome(s) you regularly select
sometimes end up bringing you low or even zero mushrooms - this is normal, just
keep following your strategy
